shared_elements: incised linear patterning on the figure
justification: Both surfaces include an anthropomorphic standing figure and some circular/disc-like and linear incised motifs, but these are broad correspondences rather than a distinctive shared iconographic scheme. The biggest difference is that A is a highly schematic frontal body-like figure dominated by geometric body markings, while B shows a more naturalistic profile winged figure interacting with a plant or standard at the side.
